reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to shifting model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.recommended_knobs.top_k=4 AND shrinkage=0.35 → aligns with regularization needs for n_windows=2
